evidence_cards.content: The objective is to distinguish between live tracks that are involved in an exercise and other live tracks being reported.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This sentence explicitly states the requirement/objective for handling track identity classification regarding exercises, which constitutes the goal of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: Track identity as defined in paragraph 4.4.2.1 is exchanged.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This directly states the high-level objective of the use case: to exchange track identity data, which aligns with the goal of managing track identity classification for the C² JU.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU may elect to accept, automatically, changes in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator received in a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1, provided the new identity is Friend and the locally held identity is not Hostile.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the high-level objective of managing track identity classification by allowing automatic acceptance of specific remote identity updates under defined conditions.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU must have a reported live track for which identity classification needs to be managed.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes the necessary system state — existence of a reported live track — before the use case can begin.

evidence_cards.content: Only tracks with standard identity of Friend can be modified by the exercise identity.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is a precondition: the track’s standard identity must already be ‘Friend’ before it can be classified as an exercise track via modification.

evidence_cards.content: A C2 JU may elect to accept changes in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator received in a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific system state (PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1) that serves as a precondition for the automatic acceptance of identity changes.

evidence_cards.content: When accepting a remote ID change, C2 JUs shall also retain the received values of the Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator fields, where those fields are implemented.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes that the implementation of specific data fields (Platform, Platform Activity, etc.) is a condition under which the C2 JU must retain values during the resolution process.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs receiving or generating a J7.2 message with the RV field set to value 2, Correlation Rejection, shall not automatically originate a request with the same Retained TN and Dropped TN for a period of 2(1-10,1) minutes.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes a temporal precondition: before initiating a new correlation request with identical track numbers after a rejection, the system must wait at least 2 minutes (with configurable range), which constrains when the use case can begin.

evidence_cards.content: When a correlation request is rejected for a manual correlation, the JU originating the request shall provide an operator alert as a cue to conduct voice coordination.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This implies that if a prior manual correlation was rejected, an operator alert must have been issued — indicating a required system state (alert presence) that may precede further action in the use case flow.

evidence_cards.content: An operator alert in the event of the rejection of an automatic correlation shall be a system option.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Clarifies that for automatic correlations, the presence of an operator alert post-rejection is optional — thus not a mandatory precondition, but still relevant context for determining whether certain states must hold before proceeding.

evidence_cards.content: After acceptance of a manual correlation the resulting track shall not be the subject of automatic decorrelation processing for a period of 5 minutes.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a time-based constraint on subsequent processing: if a manual correlation was recently accepted, automatic decorrelation is suppressed for 5 minutes — this affects whether certain preconditions (e.g., eligibility for auto-decorrelation) are met before starting related actions.

evidence_cards.content: The requirement to distinguish between live tracks involved in an exercise and other live tracks being reported is accomplished by setting the Exercise Indicator in the J3 track messages.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This identifies the specific action (setting the Exercise Indicator) that initiates the management of track identity classification for exercise distinction, serving as the trigger event for the use case.

evidence_cards.content: A C2 JU shall assume R² of an IU (including C² and nonC² JUs and forwarded PUs and RUs) in accordance with the reporting rules for a real-time track if the C² JU has correlated local sensor data, when: a. A J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds, or b. A J2 PPLI message, other than J2.0, is received with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence, or c. A J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received from the FJU for a PU, RU, or other IU, or d. The Geodetic Position Quality in the J2 PPLI message is set to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This section explicitly lists the specific events (triggers) that cause the C2 JU to initiate the management of track identity classification by assuming responsibility (R²) for an Interface Unit (IU). These conditions directly define the start boundary of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: The trigger occurs when a JU changes the Environment/Category of a track (e.g., from Space to Air) or when a difference report is rejected by an operator action.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This explicitly defines the events that start the management of identity classification conflicts, which constitutes the trigger for the use case.

evidence_cards.content: The use case is triggered when the C2 JU receives a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1, provided the new identity is Friend and the locally held identity is not Hostile.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the exact event (receipt of a specific type of track report) that initiates the automatic change in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator — directly fulfilling the trigger slot for managing track identity classification.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU distinguishes live tracks involved in an exercise by setting the Exercise Indicator to value 1 (Exercise Track) in J3 track messages; for such tracks, the standard identity is set to Friend and the specific exercise identity (e.g., FAKER or JOKER) is specified in the Identity Amplifying Descriptor field.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary successful interaction sequence where the actor sets the indicator to classify a track as exercise-involved, fulfilling the canonical success scenario.

evidence_cards.content: When the Exercise Indicator is set to value 0 (Non-Exercise Track), the standard identity of the track is specified directly in the Identity field.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the alternative successful interaction sequence where the actor classifies a track as not involved in the exercise.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is not found, the C2 JU shall integrate the received J2 PPLI report into its surveillance database as part of the surveillance picture.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific action in the main flow where the system integrates data when no correlation exists.

evidence_cards.content: If the position or other data in a PPLI meet a system's decorrelation criteria, the PPLI and local track data shall be decorrelated.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a condition and resulting action (decorrelation) within the normal processing sequence.

evidence_cards.content: After decorrelation, the C2 JU shall initiate a surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the subsequent step in the main flow following a decorrelation event.

evidence_cards.content: If the JU assumes R² (retransmission), it shall accept all defined field values for Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator for retransmission and operator appreciation.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a specific step in the main flow where the C2 JU processes identity data fields during retransmission scenarios.

evidence_cards.content: Values accepted for retransmission shall be retransmitted if the JU assumes R², unless the JU holds locally derived data other than No Statement (non-NS) for the field which differs from the value accepted for retransmission; in that case, the JU shall report the locally derived data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the logic for the main flow regarding how the JU handles conflicting data between received retransmissions and locally derived data.

evidence_cards.content: As an exception, non-NS data for the Platform, Platform Activity, and Specific Type fields received from the controlling unit for the track shall be retransmitted regardless of locally derived data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies a mandatory override rule within the main flow that ensures certain critical identity fields are always passed through from the controlling unit.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU automatically accepts changes in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator received in a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1, provided the new identity is Friend and the locally held identity is not Hostile.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary automated acceptance path (main flow) for resolving identity differences based on specific trigger conditions.

evidence_cards.content: When accepting a remote ID change, C2 JUs shall retain the received values of the Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator fields, where those fields are implemented, for retransmission and operator appreciation.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a mandatory step within the main flow regarding data retention during the resolution of differences.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU manages track identity classification by processing the J7.0 (ACT = 6) Exercise Status Order message to clear the Exercise Indicator and all artificial data from exercise tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the primary interaction step where the system receives a specific command message to manage identity classification.

evidence_cards.content: Upon receipt of the J7.0 (ACT = 6) message, the C2 JU automatically sets the Identity Amplifying Descriptor to 'Exercise Friend' for all tracks with the Exercise Indicator set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the specific action taken by the system to update the track's identity classification status as part of the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU automatically sets all data fields containing artificial information to the No Statement, default value, or actual values if held in database, and sets the Exercise Indicator to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This details the system's action to sanitize artificial data and reset the exercise indicator, completing the identity management process.

evidence_cards.content: When the Exercise Indicator is set to value 0 (Non-Exercise Track), the standard identity of the track shall be specified in the Identity field.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the alternative flow where the system distinguishes a live track as 'other' (non-exercise) rather than 'exercise-involved', diverging from the main flow step of setting the indicator to value 1.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is not found for a received J2 PPLI report, the C2 JU shall integrate the report into its surveillance database as part of the surveillance picture.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an alternative successful path where the system handles a track report that cannot be correlated with existing local data by integrating it rather than rejecting it or requiring immediate manual intervention.

evidence_cards.content: If J2 messages are not received subsequent to integration and the receiving C2 JU still has no local data, the C2 JU assumes no responsibility for reporting the subject JU on the Surveillance Network PG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the boundary condition and exit criteria for the alternative flow where correlation fails: the system integrates the data but limits its reporting responsibility if no further data arrives.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU receives ID data on a TN for which the receiving JU does not have R² and local positional data is not held, the remote ID will automatically be accepted and placed in the database for retention.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an alternative flow where the C2 JU lacks certain capabilities (R² and local position) but still successfully processes the identity classification by auto-accepting the remote data, diverging from the standard manual resolution or conflict handling paths.

evidence_cards.content: If the Local Data is PENDING or UNKNOWN and the Remote Data is HOSTILE, the C2 JU triggers an OPERATOR ALERT (Action 1*) requiring manual action to accept or reject the received ID.

evidence_cards.content: If the Local Data is ASSUMED FRIEND and the Remote Data is SUSPECT or HOSTILE, the C2 JU triggers an OPERATOR ALERT (Action 1) requiring manual action to accept or reject the received ID.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow where potential conflict between assumed friend status and suspect/hostile remote data necessitates operator decision rather than automatic rejection or acceptance.

evidence_cards.content: If the Local Data is SUSPECT and the Remote Data is HOSTILE, the C2 JU triggers an OPERATOR ALERT (Action 1*) requiring manual action to accept or reject the received ID.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a scenario where escalating from suspect to hostile (or vice versa) requires operator confirmation.

evidence_cards.content: For most combinations where Local Data is PENDING or UNKNOWN and Remote Data is not HOSTILE (e.g., FRIEND, NEUTRAL, SUSPECT), the C2 JU automatically accepts the received ID as LOCAL ID (Action 2).

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative successful flow where low-confidence local tracks are automatically updated by higher-confidence or specific remote data without operator intervention.

evidence_cards.content: If the Local Data is FRIEND, NEUTRAL, or SUSPECT and the Remote Data is PENDING, UNKNOWN, or ASSUMED FRIEND, the C2 JU automatically rejects the received ID (Action 3).

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow where the system protects established identity classifications by rejecting downgrades or less specific remote data.

evidence_cards.content: Notwithstanding standard difference resolution requirements, a C2 JU may elect to automatically accept changes in Environment/Category, Identity, or Exercise Indicator if received in a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1, provided the new identity is Friend and the locally held identity is not Hostile.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a conditional alternative flow that allows automatic acceptance of identity changes under specific message conditions (PPLI/Indicator = 1), overriding the standard resolution matrix logic for friendly updates.

evidence_cards.content: The Identity Amplifying Descriptor field shall not be set unless the Exercise Indicator field is set to value 1 (Exercise Track).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes a constraint on setting exercise identity descriptors; attempting to set them without the proper Exercise Indicator state constitutes an exception condition.

evidence_cards.content: For any track with Exercise Indicator set to value 1 (Exercise Track), data concerning the track must be considered artificial for exercise purposes, except that specific fields (Track Number, Tracking Data, Simulation Indicator, Environment/Category, Status Data) shall not be artificial.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a mandatory classification rule; failure to treat exercise tracks as artificial (except for specified exceptions) would violate the use case requirements, representing an exception flow if ignored.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is not found, the C2 JU shall integrate the received J2 PPLI report into its surveillance database as part of the surveillance picture. If J2 messages are not received subsequent to this action and the receiving C2 JU still has no local data, the C2 JU assumes no responsibility for reporting the subject JU on the Surveillance Network PG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception flow where correlation fails and subsequent data is missing, leading to the C2 JU abandoning responsibility for reporting — a clear error/unexpected condition handling path.

evidence_cards.content: If the position or other data in a PPLI meet a system's decorrelation criteria, the PPLI and local track data shall be decorrelated. After decorrelation, the C2 JU shall initiate a surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number. The PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator field and the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator field shall both be reported as No Statement.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception flow triggered by decorrelation criteria being met, resulting in reinitialization of tracking with modified identity fields — an unexpected condition requiring special handling.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if the local/remote data held indicates that both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks (i.e., being updated with local positional data).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific exception condition where automatic correlation is inhibited due to conflicting data sources (both being locally derived), which prevents the successful classification flow.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1, unless the Strength is set to No Statement.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception condition based on the 'Strength' attribute of the track, which inhibits the automatic acceptance/correlation process required for identity management.

evidence_cards.content: An ID conflict exists when the ID difference between local and remote data cannot be automatically accepted or rejected; in such cases, these differences must be presented to the operators for their evaluation.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the trigger condition for an exception flow where automatic processing fails, necessitating a manual resolution path.

evidence_cards.content: If the locally held Environment/Category of a track differs from the Environment/Category received in a J3.X or J7.0 message, the operator shall be alerted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a specific exception condition (data mismatch) that triggers an alert, interrupting the standard flow.

evidence_cards.content: If the local data and received data differ as to whether the TN is assigned to a point or to a track, the operator shall be alerted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies another specific exception condition regarding Track Number assignment that requires operator intervention.

evidence_cards.content: When a Platform, Platform Activity or Specific Type value of 0 (No Statement) is received and a non-zero value is held locally, the C2 JU retains the locally held value instead of accepting the received zero value.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception to the rule of retaining received values when the received data indicates 'No Statement' while local data is more specific.

evidence_cards.content: When an Air Platform value of 6 (Tanker), 7 (Tanker Boom Only), or 8 (Tanker Drogue Only) is held locally and a different value is received, an operator alert may be optionally triggered.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a specific scenario involving Tanker platforms where a discrepancy between local and remote data can trigger an optional alert, representing a potential exception path requiring operator attention.

evidence_cards.content: If the Reference TN is being reported in a J3.7 message, the reporting JU shall transmit all data held in a J3.7 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific condition (Reference TN in J3.7) that triggers an exception handling path where the JU must respond with surveillance information from the J3.7 message rather than standard update procedures.

evidence_cards.content: If the request is collectively addressed, any JU which has initiated an EW evaluation or association on the Reference TN in a J14.2 message shall transmit a J14.2 message with EW Action Value field set to values 7, 8, or 9 addressed to the requesting unit with the R/C field set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception flow for collective address requests involving EW evaluations, requiring specific action values (7, 8, or 9) and R/C field settings as part of the error/unexpected condition handling.

evidence_cards.content: The reported live track is distinguished as an exercise-involved live track with the Exercise Indicator set to value 1 (Exercise Track), the standard identity specified as Friend, and the specific exercise identity (e.g., FAKER or JOKER) specified in the Identity Amplifying Descriptor field.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the successful end state for classifying a track as exercise-involved, specifying the exact field values that constitute the postcondition.

evidence_cards.content: The reported live track is distinguished as another live track (Non-Exercise Track) with the Exercise Indicator set to value 0 and the standard identity of the track specified in the Identity field.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the successful end state for classifying a track as 'another live track' (non-exercise), specifying the exact field values that constitute this alternative postcondition.

evidence_cards.content: A C2 JU assuming R² of an IU reports it as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the immediate system state where the IU is reported on the network after the C2 JU assumes responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: The Identity shall be reported as Friend.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the resulting identity classification state of the track upon successful completion of the assumption process.

evidence_cards.content: The PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator shall be reported as value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the specific field values required in the postcondition state to indicate the track's status.

evidence_cards.content: The reported live track is distinguished as an exercise-involved live track, separate from other live tracks being reported.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the observable system state after successful classification in the main flow, fulfilling the postcondition of distinguishing the track's status.

evidence_cards.content: If the use of this capability changes, all participating C2 IUs will be informed through voice communication or other communications media.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies a mandatory notification action that must occur if the automatic correlation restriction settings are changed, representing a post-use-case administrative consequence.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU retains the received values of the Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator fields for retransmission and operator appreciation when assuming R^2 for a previously-reported track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the immediate observable system state regarding identity field retention after the use case completes successfully.

evidence_cards.content: If the Special Interest Indicator is set to value 1, it shall be retransmitted as value 1 by any JU assuming R^2.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies a mandatory persistent state condition for the Special Interest Indicator in the post-success scenario.

evidence_cards.content: The reported live track is distinguished as an exercise-involved live track or another live track being reported.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the resulting state of the track classification after the C2 JU resolves conflicts and reports data, satisfying the success boundary of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU with Reporting Responsibility (R²) shall respond with surveillance information upon receipt of a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message on a specific TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the immediate system state/action required for successful completion of the data update request initiated in the main flow (Step 1).

evidence_cards.content: The responding C2 JU shall transmit all data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the extent of the response required to complete the use case successfully.
